# Classwork 5

```{r}
# install.packages("ggthemes")
library(ggthemes)
library(tidyverse)

flights <- nycflights13::flights
```

```{r}
# Question 1
ggplot(data = flights,
       mapping = aes(x = air_time)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1)
```

```{r}
# Question 2
ggplot(data = flights,
       mapping = aes(x = air_time)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50,
                   fill = "lightblue") +
  facet_wrap(~origin)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = flights,
       mapping = aes(x = air_time,
                     color = origin,
                     fill = origin)) +
  geom_density(alpha = .25)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = flights,
       mapping = aes(x = air_time,
                     y = origin,
                     fill = origin,
                     )) +
  geom_boxplot(show.legend = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Question 3
top3_n <- flights |> 
  count(carrier) |> 
  arrange( desc(n) ) |> 
  head(3)  # returns the first 3 observations in the given data.frame
```

```{r}
# Question 4
top3_carriers <- flights |> 
  filter(carrier %in% c("UA", "B6", "EV")) |> 
  group_by(month, day, dep_time, carrier, origin, dest)
```

```{r}
# Question 5
ggplot(data = top3_carriers,
       mapping = aes(y = carrier,
                     fill = carrier)) +
  geom_bar(show.legend = FALSE)
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = top3_carriers,
       mapping = aes(y = carrier,
                     x = after_stat(prop),
                     group = 1)) +
  geom_bar(show.legend = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Question 6
ggplot(data = top3_carriers,
       mapping = aes(y = origin,
                     fill = carrier)) +
  geom_bar()
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = top3_carriers,
       mapping = aes(y = origin,
                     fill = carrier)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  labs(x = "Proportion") # label x-axis title
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = top3_carriers,
       mapping = aes(y = origin,
                     fill = carrier)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge")
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = top3_carriers,
       mapping = aes(y = carrier,
                     fill = carrier)) +
  geom_bar(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~origin)
```

```{r}
# Question 7
ggplot(data = top3_n,
       mapping = aes(x = n,
                     y = carrier,
                     fill = carrier)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Question 8
ggplot(data = top3_n,
       mapping = aes(x = n,
                     y = fct_reorder(carrier, n))) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(y = "Carrier")   # label y-axis title
```

```{r}
# Question 9
carrier_per_origin <- flights |> 
  count(origin, carrier) |> 
  arrange(origin, -n)
```
